name: Cat 9 - The Queen of Cinders and Chains

specialLock.label: Witness Cage
specialLock.prompt: The cage asks what all chains owe.

customItems.name: Unpaid Wage Sigil
customItems.description: A hot brass sigil representing one soul’s stolen wage.
customItems.customDescription: A hot brass sigil representing one soul’s stolen wage.

intro.text: The Deepworks found a cheaper fuel than coal: unpaid promises. A devil queen now holds the payroll chains, and every missing wage becomes another red link around a living throat.

outro.text: Three unpaid wage sigils crack together. The red links around the throne fall slack, and from far above comes the sound of miners waking from the same nightmare.

storyTriggers.title: Broken Payroll Lift
storyTriggers.text: The lift wall lists names beside wages. Every amount has been replaced by a chain mark.

storyTriggers.title: Chain Wage Hall
storyTriggers.text: Chains hang in neat rows like account books. Each one twitches when its owner’s name is spoken.

storyTriggers.title: A Witness Released
storyTriggers.text: The soul cage opens. Its prisoner leaves behind a brass sigil and the smell of rain on hot iron.

storyTriggers.title: Red Links Throne
storyTriggers.text: The Queen of Cinders and Chains lounges on a throne that looks built from contracts, shackles, and worker songs.

storyTriggers.title: Cinder Accounting
storyTriggers.text: The queen’s crown breaks into red-hot numbers. None add up anymore.

designNotes.balance: High-tier dungeon with boss plus strong lieutenants, intended as a dangerous one-shot.
designNotes.revision: Expanded to seven rooms and roughly 5-8 encounter rooms; hidden doors are one-sided from reachable rooms only.
